title: Reentrancy View Guard / Balancer ensureNotInVaultContext Protection
apparent_vulnerability: Protocol queries external pool rate or get_virtual_price() during liquidity withdrawal.
mitigating_mechanism: Oracle or lending pool explicitly checks whether the AMM pool is currently in an active lock / context via ensureNotInVaultContext() or pool.locked(), immediately reverting if reentered.
why_attack_fails: Any attempt by the attacker's fallback hook to query the oracle during liquidity withdrawal triggers ensureNotInVaultContext() and reverts the entire transaction.
